Title: Rishabh and the Family

Cast

1. Rishabh - 8 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Sonali - 42 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Riya - 11 years, friend
Look: red frock, a clip in her hair
4. Meera - 11 years, daughter
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail
5. Sharda - 68 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Rishabh stands in the living room. Sonali stands near him.]

Sonali: "Rishabh, what's the plan today?"

[Rishabh sweeps the floor with a broom.]

Rishabh: "How beautiful!"

[Rishabh mops the floor.]

Rishabh (happily): "Are you okay?"

[Rishabh irons his school shirt.]

Rishabh: "I really enjoyed today."
